summary: Implementation fully achieves the saved plan for issue #424, and the prior gap (missing validation evidence) is now resolved by a successful AWF validation run. By inspection: adapters/base.py adds the AgentAdapter.runtime_scratch_paths property defaulting to (); adapters/claude_code.py overrides it to ('.claude/worktrees/',); the new runtime/agent_scratch.py provides the sentinel-delimited, idempotent git-native exclude writer (AWF_SCRATCH_BLOCK_START/END, _strip_managed_block, _render_managed_block, apply_agent_scratch_excludes) with empty-noop, rev-parse-failure, empty-path, and OSError graceful degradation exactly as specified; control/executor/execution_flow.py wires one pre-agent call after get_adapter() using an inline 'git -C <worktree>' runner with git_safe_directory_config_args, covering initial and recovery paths. All planned TDD tests are present and structurally correct against the real APIs (CommandResult.ok/returncode/stdout/stderr; check_validation_worktree_clean with ignore_all_ignored and clean/untracked_paths/ignored_paths fields): guard-passes-once-applied, genuine-stray-still-trips, idempotent rewrite preserving non-AWF lines, per-agent sourcing + empty no-op, rev-parse failure, OSError, parametrized adapter scratch list, and the executor wiring spy, plus extra coverage for empty rev-parse output and absolute (linked-worktree) paths. Non-goals are honored: validation_worktree.py guard policy is unchanged and no target-repo .gitignore is relied upon. AWF's persisted validation run (vr_267669bb2a154c3c8e71bd03, awf-self tier 1) at HEAD 9689e2542 succeeded with VALIDATION_OK; the aggregate 99% coverage and full test gate are AWF/GitHub-CI-owned after this phase.
